text: I’ve been seeing this dentist, whom I’ve called ป้าหมอ, since I was 8 years old. She’s very kind, patient, and always makes me feel comfortable, even though I used to be so scared of dentists. The clinic is clean, modern, and well-equipped. I still come back to her every time I visit Thailand. Highly recommend!
The staff are very accommodating. The Dr. Is very transparent with regards to fees. She explained everything. The price is reasonable. The area is very tidy. Thank you so much!

Walked in to inquire about teeth cleaning services yesterday and with 10 minutes I was in the chair getting dental services by two dentists. It took less then an hour and cost 1900 THB where some other clinics in BKK wanted 7500 THB for the same cleaning. Highly recommend!!

text: Dr. Saowalak is so lovely and patient, even though I told her I was afraid of dentistry and the loud sounds of the equipment. She proceeded slowly and checked on me throughout the procedure to make sure I was okay and comfortable, and chatted with me to help me relax. Getting my teeth done here has completely lifted my fear of the dentist. The clinic is incredibly clean, with both a sofa and a counter for waiting. Dental floss, toothpaste, and mouthwash are also provided. The assistants always remind me to confirm my appointments beforehand. I'm truly impressed with the level of service, and I've been looking for this place for almost 10 years now. 🥰
I really liked it! I came for tartar removal and teeth whitening. The technician was very gentle; it didn't hurt at all. My teeth are so clean and white now. I highly recommend it!
